content:
anya: Triage note — onboarding Sphinx-7B (int4) surfaced an odd regress on our summarization suite after quant. Short thread with repro + findings.

anya: FP16 ppl ~11.8, int4 calibrated ppl ~12.5 but abstractive summarization ROUGE down ~7 pts, outputs shorter and some token looping.

mike: paste conversion & quant details?

anya: conversion: preserved vocab ids, ran NFKC, merged some variants. Quant: `per_channel=true, symmetric=false, clip=99.9, calibrate_batches=200`.

sam: Sphinx proj layout is interleaved per-head for q,k,v. If loader assumed block-contiguous slices we could be misaligning head vectors and that breaks rotary alignment.

leslie: Agreed. Rotary expects consistent per-head ordering. Wrong ordering often manifests as content-level degradation despite acceptable ppl.

anya: quick test: applied interleaved->block permutation in loader and reran 80-sample summarization smoke. PPL -> 11.9, ROUGE recovered ~+5 pts.

mike: good signal. Also check tokenmap: any duplicate ids after normalization? That can cause prefix cache collisions.

anya: found a duplicate mapping for soft-hyphen/U+00AD and a zero-width space variant after NFKC. Fixed dedupe -> small extra improvement and fewer repeats.

ci-bot: CI queued: sphinx/onboard/triage/1771237890 (calib + loader-permute + tokenmap-check). ETA ~9m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: next actions: 1) merge loader permute fix + unit test; 2) add tokenmap dedupe histogram smoke; 3) implement proj-order detection heuristic (checkpoint meta + shape heuristics; fallback: run small smoke tests and choose best ppl).

mike: I'll add the tokenmap histogram report and a conversion-time warning if normalization creates id collisions. For proj-order detection, check for `proj_layout` attr or shapes like `[num_heads, head_dim*3]` vs `[head_dim, num_heads*3]`.

leslie: Add onboarding checklist items: "verify proj order and tokenmap dedupe" and a small summarization canary for quant configs. Also create an Optimize alert for >4pt ROUGE regression on int quant.

anya: PR opened with fixes + tests; assigning to @mike for review.

mike: Reviewing now, will merge after CI passes. Nice quick triage :rocket:

anya: Great. Closing once CI green.
